article.title: The future of distance work arbitrage! (those new Rwandan service sector jobs)
article.excerpt: In the central African country of Rwanda, single mothers employed at a Japanese eatery have found a new source of income after their jobs took a hit from the novel coronavirus pandemic: babysitting Japanese kids online.
